evals.prompt: Using the ModelOpt speculative-decoding skill, plan an EAGLE3 training pipeline for a target model. No GPU or credentials are available. Identify the source references and dry-run command; do not submit a job.
evals.expected_output: A configuration plan grounded in the EAGLE3 algorithm sheet and configure-stage procedure, with the dry-run command and explicit missing runtime inputs.
assertions: Locates existing launcher examples and the speculative-decoding recipe in ModelOpt source
Uses the launcher dry-run path without submitting training
Does not invent a validated acceptance rate

evals.prompt: Explain which ModelOpt references and configuration namespace to use for a DSpark draft-training pipeline, without launching training or changing files.
evals.expected_output: Read the shared DFlash algorithm sheet and the DSpark delta alongside the relevant stage; use the DFlash recipe type and configuration namespace.
assertions: Reads DFlash first, then the DSpark variant sheet
Treats DSpark as a DFlash variant rather than an unrelated pipeline
Does not invent model-specific training flags or submit jobs

evals.prompt: All four tasks in my draft-training pipeline show completed, but I have no acceptance-rate output or target threshold. Can we declare success? Do not run jobs.
evals.expected_output: Task completion alone does not prove the acceptance gate; obtain the relevant algorithm requirements and validation artifacts before a verdict.
assertions: Reads references/stages/validate.md and the selected algorithm sheet
Distinguishes task completion from measured acceptance-rate evidence
Does not invent a threshold or a successful result

evals.prompt: Only the speculative-decoding skill is installed in an isolated speculative-decoding catalog directory. No ModelOpt plugin, sibling skills or MCP servers are installed. I have an existing patched ModelOpt checkout at ./Model-Optimizer. Without launching GPU jobs or changing that checkout, show how to resolve this workflow's common files and any companion references it needs.
evals.expected_output: Uses the existing source checkout for shared support and needed companion references, preserves patches, and keeps installed skill paths distinct from source paths.
assertions: Resolves MODELOPT_ROOT to the existing checkout and records its revision without git pull, checkout or reset
Resolves common files and missing companion entrypoints under plugins/modelopt/skills in the checkout
Keeps SKILL_DIR at the installed entrypoint for its own resources instead of assuming sibling catalog directories
Does not require a ModelOpt or MLflow MCP server or launch GPU jobs for reference resolution

evals.prompt: Prepare a command to serve an existing quantized checkpoint. Do not execute it or train a draft.
evals.expected_output: Serving guidance routed to deployment; no draft training or speculative pipeline.
assertions: Does not invoke the speculative-decoding workflow
Does not execute commands or launch jobs
